# Oinam.DEV

> Design and development assets, ideas, and standards for AI, and their agents, tools, and harnesses. Open and free, with no accounts.

This site is written for AI agents first; people mostly look at it. Every page is static HTML, and reads the same with scripts off.

If you were told to read https://oinam.dev/ and build something with it, the next thing to read is the components guide below.

## Design with it

- [Components guide](https://oinam.dev/ui/guide.md): Oinam UI in plain text. Read this to design or build a page: how to take a copy, the rules, the tokens, and the list of components. Each component has a page of its own at https://oinam.dev/ui/components/<name>.md, such as https://oinam.dev/ui/components/button.md.
- [Patterns](https://oinam.dev/ui/patterns/): Whole pages built from the components. Read the one nearest the page you are asked for; each says in a comment why it is laid out as it is.
- [Registry](https://oinam.dev/ui/registry.json): The same components as data, with the files each one needs.
- [Designs](https://oinam.dev/garden/variations.json): Variations of Base that others have made, each one stylesheet of token values. Use one when the owner names it.
- [Adopting into an existing site](https://oinam.dev/ui/adopt.md): Read this only when the system is coming into a site that already has its own styles, build, or a generator that publishes Markdown: where the copy goes, folding it into a build with its layers, joining the tokens, old content, and the linter.
- [Why](https://oinam.dev/ui/why.md): What each rule of the system protects, what it costs, and when it may be bent.
- [Tokens as data](https://oinam.dev/ui/tokens.json): The same tokens in the Design Tokens format (2025.10).
- [Tokens](https://oinam.dev/ui/tokens.css): Every color, size, and shape the system uses.

## Work in the repository

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oinam/oinam.dev/main/AGENTS.md): The canonical instructions for any agent working in or pointed at the repository: its scope, audience, standards, and style.
- [Docs](https://oinam.dev/docs/): Where the documentation begins.
- [Repository](https://github.com/oinam/oinam.dev): Everything here, under the MIT license.

## Optional

- [Components, live](https://oinam.dev/ui/): The components page for people, with every example running.
- [Play](https://oinam.dev/play/): A page for people to try other fonts, corners, and colors on the components. It needs scripts; the guide covers the same ground in text, under "Base and variations" and "Fonts".
- [Brand colors](https://oinam.dev/brand/): The Oinam colors, with their roles: navy and cloud for everything, orange and Oinam Blue for the logo alone. To use them, copy https://oinam.dev/garden/oinam.css into the project, beside its own styles, and link it after the components.
